title: Uttarakhand Suspends Tree Felling For Rishikesh-Bhaniyawala Highway Expansion Pending Stakeholder Consensus And Environmental Review
description: The Uttarakhand government has temporarily suspended the proposed felling of nearly 3,000 trees for the Rishikesh-Bhaniyawala four-lane highway project, with Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami directing officials to pause the exercise until a broad consensus is reached among all stakeholders.The decision follows sustained opposition from environmental groups, local residents, students and civil society organisations, who have raised concerns over the impact of the project on the ecologically sen
